title: Answer
description: What the agent passes to submit_answer. The format reward is 1 iff this validates.

answer.description: Single normalized value (string, number, or boolean). Lists like 'A or B' are not accepted as a match. Use the string NOT_FOUND to abstain.

id.description: Record id: set_id (label), safetyreportid (event), application_number (drugsfda). For an empty search result, the step index of that tool call as 'step:<n>'.

field.description: Dotted path in the record, e.g. boxed_warning, submissions, meta.results.total.
